messages:
Mina: Quick synthesis from the KV shard flapping postmortem. We need an ownership matrix for remediation -> tests: regression promptset, focused load test, and a controlled chaos drill to exercise shard-eviction fallbacks. Also add a note: recurring incident pattern shows spikes align with nightly batch window.

Josh: Good call. Let's capture the recurrence pattern in the ticket and add a regression fingerprint to the promptset so CI can catch it. Immediate = promptset, medium = load harness + TTL override, longer = chaos drill + warmup policy.

Carla: I can curate the promptset. Will extract representative traces and produce 5 seeds (cold-start, long-context, batch-aligned spike, streaming low-bandwidth, many-small). ETA: end of sprint (Thu).

Sam: I'll build the load harness. Plan: k6 scenario that ramps 50->1800 rps across 10m and includes an optional TTL override stage via admin API to force eviction. I'll add a safe kill-switch and traffic cap. Need trace window for realistic mix. @Josh please attach traces.

Josh: Trace link: https://redwood.internal/trace/EVT-2026-kv-evict. Ops snapshot in TICKET-4821. I'll also document the batch-job alignment.

Mina: Acceptance criteria for promptset: should detect regressions in CI. Define regression = >12% p99 latency or >1.8x token generation cost vs baseline. Prompts to live under evals/kv-evict/ and run nightly. Add metadata: "eviction_fingerprint" to help triage.

Carla: Will open PR with prompts, expected outputs, and the fingerprint. Also adding variants that exercise streaming vs non-streaming code paths.

Sam: Example TTL override command I'll include as a step in the k6 pipeline:
```
# set TTL low for shard group
curl -s -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \
  https://ops-api.internal/shards/7/override-ttl -d '{"ttl_seconds":20}'
```
I'll make the override gated behind a feature flag and a playbook precheck.

ops-bot: Created TICKET-5102 "kv-evict: promptset + load + chaos drill" assigned Carla, Sam, Josh. Due 2026-05-21.

QA-bot: Nightly eval job configured: evals/kv-evict runs 03:00 UTC, posts failures to #eng-platform and opens a regression alert candidate in the evals dashboard.

Josh: Proposed drill cadence: tabletop on Tue (scenario walkthrough), live drill Wed (controlled eviction). Who leads tabletop?

Carla: I'll draft the scenario doc and checklist (prechecks, rollback, observability asserts) and share by Mon.

Sam: I'll prepare the live playbook with a kill-switch and traffic cap; will rehearse in staging first.

Josh: I'll add monitoring asserts: sustained cache-miss rate >4% for 3m -> alert SRE; add a dashboard showing eviction_fingerprint and request mix.

Mina: Owners recap: Carla = promptset PR by Thu (TICKET-5103), Sam = load script + TTL override by next Tue (TICKET-5104), Josh = monitoring + trace docs by Mon (TICKET-5105). Tabletop Tue, live drill Wed next sprint. I'll take the post-drill writeup and update the postmortem with links to PRs and lessons.

Carla: Acceptance test: promptset must fail CI if any model/service change increases cold-start token cost >20% or changes the eviction_fingerprint.

Sam: Load test pass criteria: p95/p99 within baseline thresholds under synthetic spike AND token cost <2x baseline; will publish numeric thresholds after baseline run.

Mina: Also, add remediation column in the kanban: "short-term mitigations" (promptset + alarms) vs "long-term" (warm caching policy + canary TTL rollout). I'll update the ticket when PRs land.

Josh: Please loop product on rollout impact. Carla will ping them in the PR.

Mina: Thanks everyone. Keeping thread open until TICKET-5102 moves to In Progress. Ping here if anything slips.
